newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos buys food business for S$7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos buys food business for S$7 mln.

text.p: Cerebos Pacific Ltd (CPL) said on Thursday it would acquire the business assets of Asian Home Gourmet Pte Ltd (AHG) and a 50 percent stake in Fair Orient Ltd from Home Gourmet Ltd (HGL) for Singapore $7 million.
Cerebos said the acquisition of AHG's business assets would be through its wholly-owned subsidiary Ruby Food Traders Pte Ltd, which would be renamed CPL (AHG) Pte Ltd.
Cerebos added its subsidiary CUB (Hong Kong) Co Ltd would acquire the stake in Fair Orient, which would be renamed Home Gourmet (International) Ltd.
The acquisitions are expected to be completed no later than December 27, 1996.
Cerebos said CUB and CPL would take over the business of marketing all the products of HGL and AGH.
HGL and AGH are engaged in the development and marketing of a wide range of Asian seasoning and spices.
